_note: Hybrid progression (Levels 1-100). XP comes only from verified engine events (WorldState.record_activity changes). FIRST discoveries / victories / trials pay full value exactly once (keyed in progress.awarded, so nothing can be paid twice); repeats pay a small, decaying amount (repeat_base / (1 + decay * n)), and easy fights pay less once a mage has outgrown them. Every 10th level is an Orbit Gate: XP alone stops at level 9, 19, ...; the gate needs real milestones defined per mage in data/mages.json. Cumulative XP to reach level L = curve_base * (L-1) ^ curve_exp.

defeat._note: first victory over a monster kind pays `first`, later ones pay `repeat` decaying by 0.5 per previous kill of that kind; once the mage's level exceeds `outgrown_at` the repeat value halves again
